1719: once exiled from the Woodland, who have returned

1721: relics belong to the Keepers or the Woodland, though,
1722: is another question. To accomplish their mission, they
1723: will need to delve relics out of the forests, move them to
1724: a waystation of the same type, and then recover them.

1726: the relic’s value of one to three, and they also score two
1727: points each time they complete a set of the three rel­
1728: ic types—figures, tablets, and jewelry. Over time, the
1729: Keepers will gather a Retinue of Woodland creatures,
1730: letting them take more actions. However, each time
1731: they delve a relic or recover one, they might lose the
1732: Retinue  card they used to act, so they will need to plan
1733: ahead and take prudent risks in order to succeed.
